items.text: Remia abanto baane! Ee, remia abanto baane!
naende ng’a Yerusalemu onyorire okwaberwa ara kabere
rongeyia enchera enene ase Omonene, Nyasae oito, agwo ase erooro.
na kera egetunwa na ekegoro nabiiranigwe inse,
na Mwanyabaanto bonsi mbaborore bare amo.
“Raria ng’a Mwanyabaanto bonsi nigo banga buna obonyansi,
obuya bwabo bwonsi nigo bonga egesicha kere mogondo.
Obonyansi nigo bokwoma, na ebisicha boigo,
naboigo na Mwanyabaanto banga buna obonyansi.
Ee, obonyansi nigo bokwoma, na ebisicha boigo,
korende ring’ana ria Nyasae oito nigo rirabeo goika kare na kare.”
tiira gochia ase ebitunwa ebitambe igoro.
Rora, Omonene ngocha are ore nokobua,
Naama! Nigo agocha obwate eng’eria yaye,
na ebiasakoire nigo bire ase obosio bwaye.
Narisie riicho riaye buna omorisia akorisia ching’ondi chiaye,
na echi chire ne chimanwa ching’are nachiraae ng’ora ng’ora.
Nyasae bw’Abaisraeli tari koreng’anigwa na onde
Ning’o orengire amaache e chinyancha noroe rw’okoboko kwaye?
Ning’o oramboire ebiara bi’amaboko aye korenga igoro?
Ning’o obekire orotu rw’ense ase ekerengero,
gose ning’o orengire ebitunwa na ebigoro nekerengero?
Naama! Ebisaku nigo binga buna entonyi y’amaache egotonya korwa ase enyongo.
Nigo bireng’anirie norotu orosinini rore ase esani ekorengera;
rora, nigo akoimokia ebisinka buna orotu orosinini.
Emete ye rinani ria Lebanoni tegoisana ebe chinko chigouterwa omorero,
ne ching’iti chionsi chireo tichigoisana chibe ekeng’wanso ki’ogosaambwa.
Ebisaku bionsi nigo bire bosa ase obosio bwaye,
nigo abibarete buna negento bosa, bitaisaini kende.
Omogwekano bw’ogosasimwa nigo okobombwa nomooroisia ebinto,
Omonto ore omotaka otabwati ebinge akorua
Timwana goteebigwa amang’ana ayio korwa omochakano?
Timwana koyamanya korwa omochakano bw’oboroso bw’ense?
Ere nere oikaransete ase orosingo rw’ense,
na abamenyete ase ense nigo banga buna ebisase;
nere okorambora igoro chionsi buna egetambaa gekoramborwa,
ee, nigo agochirambora buna eema ekomenywa ekoramborwa.
Omonene nigo agokeyia abagaambi baba bosa,
na abagaambi ebiina b’ense boigo baba bosa.
Abwo nigo banga buna ebimeri bisimekire masomberera,
na omoubera noro obairurukia buna okoirurukia obonyansi obwomo.
Nere oria okoraa emeganda y’ebitongwa ebio ase omobaro obo,
na koroka kera ekemo erieta riaye.
ne chinguru chiaye nigo chire nokobua,
ase ayio kende tikeremeti nonya nekemo.
Inwe abanto ba Yakobo, inwe Abaisraeli,
naende ng’a ere Nyasae obarinire oboronge bwaino?
ng’a Omonene nigo are Nyasae o kare na kare,
Obong’aini bwaye tibokorigigwa bomanyekane buna bore.
Ere nigo akoa omonto oyo ogoyire chinguru,
na oyo otari na nguru nigo akomomentera chinguru.
korende abwo baganyete na gosemeri’Omonene mbaegwe chinguru chinyia,
mbairuruke gochia igoro ne chimbaaba buna echi’ebiongo;
